result.stderr:
DESCRIPTION:
Compile a DialogueDown script

USAGE:
    ddown compile <script> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    ddown compile scene.dialogue.md
    ddown compile scene.dialogue.md --mode best-effort
    ddown compile scene.dialogue.md --emit dot -o stages.dot

ARGUMENTS:
    <script>    The .dialogue.md script to compile

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help             Prints help information                              
        --config <PATH>    The dialogue.toml to configure the compile. Default: 
                           the nearest one found from the script's folder upward
        --mode <MODE>      How far to compile after an error: stage-boundary    
                           (default) or best-effort                             
        --emit <FORMAT>    What to write: 'playbook' (the default) for a        
                           compiled playbook, or 'dot' for each stage's graph as
                           Graphviz text                                        
    -o, --output <PATH>    Where the emitted text goes, by convention           
                           <script>.playbook.json. Default: standard output

result.stderr:
DESCRIPTION:
Visualize a DialogueDown script's compilation

USAGE:
    ddown visualize [script] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    ddown visualize scene.dialogue.md
    ddown visualize scene.dialogue.md --edit
    ddown visualize --root scripts
    ddown visualize scene.dialogue.md -o report.html --no-open

ARGUMENTS:
    [script]    The .dialogue.md script to visualize. Omit it to browse for one 
                in the report's Explorer                                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help             Prints help information                              
        --root <DIR>       The folder the report's Explorer browses and serves  
                           (the security boundary). Default: the current        
                           directory                                            
        --edit             Open the report in Edit mode (editable, saves back to
                           the file). Default: View (read-only, auto-updating)  
    -o, --output <PATH>    Write a self-contained report to this path (a        
                           non-interactive export; requires a script)           
        --config <PATH>    The dialogue.toml to configure the report. Default:  
                           the nearest one found from the script's folder       
                           upward, within --root                                
        --port <PORT>      The loopback port for the server (default: an        
                           ephemeral port)                                      
        --no-open          Do not open the report in the browser
